subject: Condensed Memory Screening Speeds Up Early Detection of Alzheimer's Disease
script: From Agewell Brief: Condensed Memory Screening Speeds Up Early Detection of Alzheimer's Disease. Accelerated cognitive evaluations could help health systems rapidly identify early dementia and streamline access to emerging disease-modifying therapies as global cases rise. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
